Literary and effectively extinct. Survives only after apenas, en cuanto, no bien.

Recognise, never produce.

Legal and proverbial only: sea lo que fuere; adonde fueres, haz lo que vieres.

hubiere + participle: hubiere hablado…

Contracts and old statutes. Recognition only.
Only to read them without confusion. They occupy three of the sixteen traditional cells, which is why the count is 16 but live usage is 13.
